hypothesis: Rotating category-group meta-holdout and worst-group loss can prevent selective relation collapse on unseen fit-category groups while preserving exact raw fallback safety.
source: frozen Phase76AR counterfactual examples and Phase76S feature contract
grouping: sorted fit categories split deterministically into four groups; no held validation category enters training
objective: weighted cross entropy plus 0.5 times the maximum per-group cross entropy over three training groups; holdout group rotates each update
decision: HELP argmax uses frozen relation; HARM/NEUTRAL returns exact raw
